name: Image Optimizer X
author: Daniel X

sections.description:
ImageOptimizerX is your ultimate solution for optimizing images in WordPress with ease and efficiency. Say goodbye to slow-loading pages and bloated media libraries! This powerful yet user-friendly plugin automatically compresses images, converts them to the modern WebP format, and resizes oversized images—all while uploading to your WordPress media library.

Why Choose ImageOptimizerX?

  • Boost Site Speed: Smaller image files mean faster page loads, improving user experience and SEO rankings.
  • Save Disk Space: Reduce image sizes by up to 80% without noticeable quality loss.
  • Modern WebP Format: Leverage next-gen image technology for superior compression and quality.
  • Beginner-Friendly: Sleek, intuitive interface with smart defaults—no technical skills required.
  • Real-Time Feedback: See exactly how much space you’ve saved and how much faster your images load.

Key Features

  • Automatic Compression: Adjust quality (1-100) to balance size and clarity.
  • WebP Conversion: Optional toggle to convert JPG/PNG to WebP for cutting-edge performance.
  • Smart Resizing: Automatically scale down large images to a max width/height (e.g., 1920×1080 by default).
  • Performance Stats: After upload, get instant reports on space saved (KB and %) and estimated speed gains (seconds).
  • Customizable Settings: Tailor the plugin to your needs with a simple, modern settings page.

Free vs PRO

ImageOptimizerX comes in two versions to fit your needs:

FREE Version:
– ✓ Automatic optimization on upload
– ✓ WebP conversion
– ✓ Smart resizing
– ✓ Quality control (1-100)
– ✓ Individual image optimization in Media Library
– ✓ Performance statistics popup

PRO Version — Everything in Free, plus:
– ⭐ Bulk Optimization — Optimize your entire media library with one click
– ⭐ Date Range Filter — Select specific time periods to optimize only the images you need
– ⭐ Pause & Resume — Stop optimization anytime and continue later without losing progress
– ⭐ Detailed Statistics — Comprehensive reports on scanned images, total size, and estimated savings
– ⭐ Progress Tracking — Real-time progress with ETA calculation and current file display
– ⭐ Priority Support — Get fast, dedicated support from our expert team
– ⭐ Lifetime Updates — Receive all future updates and improvements at no extra cost

PRO Features in Detail

Bulk Optimization
Have thousands of images uploaded before installing ImageOptimizerX? No problem! The Bulk Optimization feature scans your entire media library and optimizes all images in one go. Perfect for existing websites that need a performance boost.

Date Range Filter
Need to optimize only recent uploads? Or perhaps images from a specific campaign? The date range filter lets you target exactly the images you want, saving time and server resources.

Pause & Resume
Large media libraries can take time to process. With Pause & Resume, you can stop the optimization process at any time and continue later. Your progress is automatically saved, so you never lose work.

Real-Time Progress
Watch your optimization in real-time with detailed progress tracking:
– Number of images processed vs total
– Space saved so far
– Current file being optimized
– Elapsed time and estimated time remaining (ETA)

Perfect for bloggers, e-commerce sites, photographers, and anyone who wants a faster, leaner WordPress site. Whether you’re managing a small blog or a high-traffic WooCommerce store, ImageOptimizerX ensures your images look great while keeping your site lightning-fast.

Why It Matters

In 2025, website performance is non-negotiable. Google prioritizes fast-loading sites, and users expect instant access. With ImageOptimizerX, you’re not just optimizing images—you’re optimizing your entire online presence. Don’t let unoptimized media slow you down—take control today!

By deeply optimizing your images, ImageOptimizerX becomes a powerful ally for improving both SEO and overall site performance. Search engines prioritize Core Web Vitals, and lighter, efficiently compressed images play a crucial role in achieving strong LCP and FID scores. When paired with popular caching plugins—such as WP Super Cache, W3 Total Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, or any modern performance optimizer—ImageOptimizerX delivers a double speed boost: the cache serves already-optimized, lightweight images, resulting in near-instant page loads. This combination helps your site rank higher in search results, reduce bounce rates, and deliver a significantly smoother user experience, especially on mobile devices.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the image-optimizer-x folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > ImageOptimizerX to configure your preferences.
  4. Start uploading images and watch the magic happen!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect image quality?

No! You control the compression quality (default is 80), ensuring a balance between size and visuals.

Can I disable WebP conversion?

Yes, simply toggle off the “Convert to WebP” option in the settings.

What happens to my original images?

If WebP is enabled, the original is replaced with the optimized WebP version to save space. Otherwise, the original is overwritten with the compressed version.

Will it resize all images?

Only if “Resize Large Images” is enabled and the image exceeds the maximum width or height you’ve set.

What’s the difference between Free and PRO versions?

The Free version automatically optimizes images when you upload them. The PRO version adds Bulk Optimization to process your entire existing media library, plus advanced features like date filtering, pause/resume, and detailed statistics.

How do I upgrade to PRO?

Go to Settings > ImageOptimizerX and scroll down to the “Upgrade to PRO” section. Click “Buy PRO License” to purchase. Your license key is displayed on the settings page — use it during checkout for automatic activation.

How do I activate my PRO license?

After purchasing, go to Settings > ImageOptimizerX and click “Restore Purchase”. The plugin will automatically verify and activate your license based on your domain.

Can I use PRO on multiple sites?

Each PRO license is valid for one domain. If you need to use ImageOptimizerX PRO on multiple sites, please purchase additional licenses.

What if I move my site to a new domain?

Contact our support team to transfer your license to the new domain. We’re happy to help with domain changes.

Is there a trial for PRO features?

Currently, we don’t offer a trial, but we provide a satisfaction guarantee. If PRO doesn’t meet your needs, contact us within 14 days for a full refund.

How does Bulk Optimization work?

  1. Click “Start Scan” to find all optimizable images in your media library
  2. Review the results: number of images, total size, and estimated savings
  3. Click “Start Optimization” to begin processing
  4. Watch real-time progress or pause anytime to continue later
